QuestInfo.name: Destructive Creation
QuestInfo.0: The third paradox is destructive creation. Ask Grendel the Really Old about it.
QuestInfo.1: Defeat the Axe Stumps in the #m102020300# to gather destructive creation. #bDouble-click the #i2430873# Vampiric Lantern#k to go there and eliminate #b50 Axe Stumps#k. #bDouble-click the Vampiric Lantern#k to return when all's said and done.
QuestInfo.2: You eliminated the Axe Stumps and gathered what you came for.

0.0: Paradox is what we need to get to harmony. Do you not agree?\r\n#L0##bIf I say yes, can we get on with this nonsense?#l\n#k
0.1: Aurora seeks the truth in paradoxes. Light and Dark are two sides of the same coin. They can't exist together, yet they do. I think you'll come to understand this later.\r\n#L0##bDo you have the answer, or do you intend to keep me here with your babbling all day?#l\n#k
0.2: Listen well. There are mountainous areas that are very dry in Perion, on the northeast side of Victoria Island. The monsters there, called Axe Stumps, are part trees but still have the axe that felled them embedded in them. They embody that contradictory meaning in their grim appearance.\r\n#L0##bYou mean to say, that is destructive creation?#l\n#k
0.3: Yes. #bDouble-click on the Vampiric Lantern#k and hunt #b50 Axe Stumps#k at the Big Rocky Road.

yes.0: Remember to #dDouble-click on the Vampiric Lantern#k to return.

no.0: I hope you aren't planning any more trouble...

1.0: Just one paradox to go. Let's get this over with.

mob.0: Axe Stumps have very tough bark, but I think your powers are strong enough to break through.
